When p points to an align character after multi-byte fill bytes, the fill string_view is constructed with size p-begin; if this size exceeds fill_t::max_size=4, fill_t::operator= throws 'invalid fill'.
The fill size check prevents buffer overflow in fill_t::data_; a 5+ byte fill throws an exception instead of overflowing.
